    AI Overview
    Recent matchups between the Oklahoma City Thunder and Detroit Pistons (2024–2026) have been dominated by the Thunder, though the Pistons secured a notable 124-116 win on February 25, 2026, behind Jalen Duren and Cade Cunningham, according to ESPN and YouTube. The teams met again in March 2026, with both teams managing injuries in the latter part of the season, note NBA and Flashscore.com. 
    Timeline of Key Matchups (2023–2026) 
    • March 30, 2026: NBA reports a match scheduled at Paycom Center in Oklahoma City.
    • February 25, 2026: ESPN and YouTube report the Pistons defeated the short-handed Thunder 124-116 in Detroit, with Jalen Duren and Cade Cunningham both scoring 29 points
      .
    • April 2, 2025: NBA and YouTube report Oklahoma City won 119-103, with strong performances from SGA and Jalen Williams.
    • March 15, 2025: NBA notes a 113-107 win for the Thunder.
    • January 28, 2024: NBA reports a 120-104 victory for the Thunder.
    • October 30, 2023: NBA reports the Thunder won 124-112. 
    The two teams have operated at opposite ends of the standings during these matchups, with Oklahoma City contending for the top spot in the Western Conference while the Pistons have been in a rebuilding phase, according to NBA and YouTube.
